en.title: Why Mistakes Make People Like You Instantly
en.description:
Do you always try to be perfect? 👇
Psychology shows minor blunders actually boost your likability.
It is called the Pratfall Effect.
🧠 Follow for a daily brain bias check 👇

fr.title: Pourquoi tes erreurs te rendent attachant
fr.description:
Tu cherches toujours à être parfait ? 👇

C'est l'Effet de Chute.
🧠 Abonne-toi pour ton check-up mental quotidien 👇
